newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Exports lift white wheat.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Exports lift white wheat.

text.p: White wheat cash bids were higher on Friday amid expectations Pakistan will buy U.S. white wheat in its tender slated for Monday, several cash grain dealers said.
"We should see some of the Pakistan business," a merchant said. "They usually buy white wheat."
Pakistan is set to tender on Monday for 500,000 tonnes of optional origin wheat. Export sources said they expected Pakistan would buy no more than 250,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat.
Durum bids continued to surge, climbing another 15 to 25 cents a bushel on top of Thursday's sharp gains.
Merchandisers cited reports of scab damage and potential yield losses due to persistent wet weather.
Dark northern spring wheat bids were down, in line with weakness in MGE futures.
